text: Remote SSH（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：从 SSH 配置中选择远程主机，在 DSH 侧栏管理连接，并通过 SSH 本地端口转发打开远端 DSH Web。插件在服务端注册主机、状态、连接和设置接口，客户端提供主机面板及插件设置页。连接时建立或复用隧道，读取远端 Web token 后生成本地访问地址。适合希望在浏览器中使用另一台可 SSH 访问的机器上 DSH 的用户；本机需安装 OpenSSH，远端需运行 DSH Web。

Remote SSH adds a sidebar for choosing SSH-configured hosts and opening their DSH web interfaces. It creates an SSH local port forward, obtains the web token, and opens a browser URL. OpenSSH is required locally.
想通过 SSH 隧道在浏览器里打开另一台电脑上的 DSH。
能不能直接从 SSH 配置选主机并连接远端 DSH？
I want to connect to a remote DSH web UI through an SSH port forward.
Remote SSH 的功能「SSH 连接远端 DSH」：在侧栏选择 SSH 配置中的主机后建立本地端口转发，获取远端 DSH Web 地址并可在浏览器打开；断开操作可关闭隧道。

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · dsh-remote-ssh：SSH remote hosts for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com): pick a machine from your existing `~/.ssh/config`, keep an SSH local forward alive, and open that machine's DSH web UI in your browser.

It is the DSH equivalent of VS Code Remote-SSH — same SSH config, same keys, same jump hosts, but the remote side serves DSH instead of a language server.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Features：- **Hosts come from `~/.ssh/config`** — one source of truth, nothing to retype
- **One click connect / disconnect** — runs `ssh -N -L <local>:127.0.0.1:<remote>`
- **Automatic web token** — reads the last matching line of the remote log (matched by port) and verifies it through the tunnel before you ever see a 401
- **Actionable failures** — port in use, network unreachable, and authentication failure each get their own next step
- **Password / MFA hosts** — a dialog asks for the password when needed; it is used for that connection only and never written to disk
- Works with ProxyJump / ProxyCommand, passphrase keys via `ssh-agent`, and ControlMaster session reuse
- Ships a `remote-dsh-ops` skill so an agent can turn a bare machine into a remote DSH host

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin add @strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh
```

Reload DSH, then look for **Remote SSH** in the sidebar.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Usage：1. Sidebar → **Remote SSH** → **+**
2. Pick a host from your SSH config
3. Click **Connect**
4. Click the external-link icon to open the remote DSH UI

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Requirements：| Side | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.5` or newer |
| Local machine | OpenSSH client. macOS / Linux fully supported. Windows: key auth and tunneling work; password auth is untested |
| Remote machine | macOS / Linux. A Windows remote is reached through a PowerShell token lookup that is untested |

**The plugin does not provide reachability.** If the host is not already reachable over SSH (LAN, VPN, Tailscale, jump host), the connection fails — by design.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Settings：| Setting | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| SSH config path | Empty means `~/.ssh/config` |
| Default remote port | Fallback for new hosts and when opening (default `3000`) |
| Start the remote DSH automatically | Off by default. When on, connecting to a host whose `dsh web` is down will launch it |
| Stop the remote DSH when disconnecting | Off by default. When on, disconnecting also stops the process listening on the DSH port |

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Starting the remote DSH：If the tunnel is up but `dsh web` is not answering, the error offers **Start remotely**: the plugin runs a launch command on the remote, waits up to 30 seconds for it to become ready, and then continues opening the UI.

If the token found in the log no longer matches the process that is actually running (usually because `dsh web` was started more than once), the error offers **Restart remote DSH**: it stops the listener on that port and starts a fresh process, which prints a matching token.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Starting the remote DSH：The row also shows three states: **Idle** (no tunnel), **Service not responding** (tunnel up but the port is silent, or answers like something other than DSH) and **Ready**. A DSH web answers `GET /` with **401** when no session cookie is present; anything else on that port is reported as "not DSH" with an AI-assisted repair action. If a local port is held by a leftover ssh that is not ours, the error offers **Clean up port**, which matches only ssh processes carrying our exact forward and ends them; nothing else is touched.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Starting the remote DSH：The default launch command resolves whichever install exists (`dsh` on `PATH`, else `~/.local/dsh/node_modules/.bin/dsh`), detaches with `setsid` when available, and logs to `~/.dsh-web.log`. A host may override it with its own command, where `{port}` is replaced by the remote DSH port.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Per-host options：| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Remote DSH port | Where `dsh web` listens on the remote |
| Local port | Leave empty to auto-assign; pinning it keeps the browser cookie valid (cookies bind to `hostname:port`) |
| Web token | Usually empty — read from the remote log on every connect. Fill it only to pin a value |
| Start command | Optional override used when the plugin has to start `dsh web`; `{port}` is substituted |

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · How it works：- The host half registers `/api/remote-ssh/*` **inside DSH's authenticated `/api` channel**, reads and writes a small registry, spawns `ssh`, and parses the token
- The client half renders the panel and talks to the same-origin API
- Connect flow: open the tunnel → HTTP health probe through the tunnel → read the token → verify the token (expect `303`) → return the URL
- The token lives in memory only; the registry is written with `0600` permissions
- A leftover tunnel from a previous DSH run is reported as a port conflict instead of being mistaken for a live connection

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Security：- Custom routes ride DSH's authenticated `/api` channel: Host / Origin checks and the owner principal are enforced by the connection layer before this plugin runs
- SSH destinations starting with `-` are rejected, so a registry entry cannot smuggle an ssh option
- Passwords reach ssh through `SSH_ASKPASS`: not on the command line, not in logs, not on disk
- The plugin never reads or copies your private keys — which keys are used is up to `~/.ssh/config`
- The browser cookie is issued by the remote `dsh web` and lasts 30 days by default

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Platform support：| | macOS | Linux | Windows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plugin (client) — tunnel, token, browser | ✅ verified | ✅ | ⚠️ key auth only; password auth and port cleanup unsupported |
| Remote host — token read | ✅ verified | ✅ verified | ⚠️ PowerShell fallback, unverified |
| Remote host — start / stop DSH | ✅ verified | ✅ verified | ❌ commands are POSIX |

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Platform support：On Windows the plugin omits `ControlMaster` (Windows OpenSSH has no multiplexing), uses a `.cmd` askpass helper for passwords (unverified), and rejects automatic port cleanup with an explicit message. Ending the leftover `ssh` process from Task Manager clears the port.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · Development：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: routes, registry, ssh processes, skill registration |
| `client.js` | Client half: panel and dialogs |
| `skills/remote-dsh-ops/SKILL.md` | Runbook for preparing a machine as a remote DSH host |
| `locale/` | Plugin metadata strings |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle insert declaration |

Local UI checks live in `scripts/` and are intentionally not tracked.

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 中文说明：从 `~/.ssh/config` 里选一台机器，保持一条 SSH 本地转发，然后在浏览器里打开那台机器上的 DSH Web 界面。

这是 DSH 版的 VS Code Remote-SSH：同一份 SSH 配置、相同的密钥与跳板机，只是远端跑的是 DSH。

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 功能：- **主机列表直接来自 `~/.ssh/config`**，不重复维护连接信息
- **一键连接 / 断开**：`ssh -N -L <本地>:127.0.0.1:<远端>`
- **自动读取 web token**：按端口取远端日志的最后一条匹配行，并通过隧道验证后再交给浏览器
- **错误可操作**：端口占用、网络不通、认证失败分别给出下一步
- **密码 / MFA 主机**：需要时弹窗输入，仅用于本次连接，不落盘
- 支持 ProxyJump / ProxyCommand、`ssh-agent` 中的口令密钥、ControlMaster 会话复用
- 附带 `remote-dsh-ops` skill，可让 agent 把一台空机器准备成远程 DSH 主机
@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 使用：侧栏「远程 SSH」→「+」→ 选主机 → 「连接」→ 点外链图标打开远端界面。

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 依赖：- DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` 或更新
- 本机：OpenSSH 客户端（macOS / Linux 完整支持；Windows 的密码认证未验证）
- 远端：macOS / Linux（Windows 远端走 PowerShell 读 token，未验证）

**本插件不提供可达性。** 如果这台机器本来就不能通过 SSH 到达（局域网、VPN、Tailscale、跳板机），连接会失败——这是刻意的边界。

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 设置：| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| SSH 配置文件路径 | 留空表示 `~/.ssh/config` |
| 默认远端端口 | 新主机与打开时的兜底值（默认 3000） |
| 远端未运行时自动启动 | 默认关闭。打开后，连接到 `dsh web` 没运行的主机会自动启动它 |
| 断开时同时停止远端 DSH | 默认关闭。打开后，断开会在远端停掉监听该端口的进程 |

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 每台主机：| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 远端 DSH 端口 | `dsh web` 在远端的监听端口 |
| 本地端口 | 留空自动分配；固定它可让浏览器 cookie 长期有效 |
| Web token | 一般留空，每次连接自动读取 |
| 启动命令 | 可选；插件需要启动远端时执行，`{port}` 会替换为远端端口 |
@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 启动远端 DSH：默认启动命令会自动探测安装位置（`PATH` 里的 `dsh`，或 `~/.local/dsh/node_modules/.bin/dsh`），有 `setsid` 时用它脱离会话，日志写到 `~/.dsh-web.log`。每台主机可以覆盖这条命令，`{port}` 会被替换为远端端口。

@strepsiades/dsh-remote-ssh README · 安全：- 自定义路由挂在 DSH 已鉴权的 `/api` 通道内，Host / Origin 校验与 owner 身份由 Connection 层完成
- 拒绝以 `-` 开头的 SSH 目的地，避免参数注入
- 密码经 `SSH_ASKPASS` 交给 ssh：不进命令行、不进日志、不落盘
- 插件不读取也不复制私钥，使用哪些密钥完全取决于 `~/.ssh/config`
- 浏览器 cookie 由远端 `dsh web` 签发，默认 30 天
